plugins.name: ai-context-bridge-for-hubspot
plugins.description: Connects Claude to a real SQL Server mirror of your HubSpot portal (deals, pipeline, contacts, engagements, email, workflows) and teaches Claude the schema, SQL Server dialect gotchas, and proven analytics recipes for it — so you get joins, CTEs, and window functions HubSpot's own report builder can't do.

skills.name: hubspot-analytics
skills.description: Use when the user has connected their DataLabs "AI Context Bridge for HubSpot" MCP connector (tools like execute_query, get_tables_list, get_full_database_schema, get_semantic_metadata, save_query, list_saved_queries pointed at mcp.datalabs.store) and asks analytical questions about their HubSpot data — deals, pipeline, contacts, companies, engagements, email campaigns, or workflows. Also use for schema exploration ("what tables do I have"), SQL generation/debugging against this connector, or reproducing/adapting known revenue-ops analyses (weighted pipeline, forecast calibration, stuck deals, engagement-vs-win-rate, revenue concentration, email attribution).
skills.description_zh: 在已连接 DataLabs 的 AI Context Bridge for HubSpot MCP（mcp.datalabs.store）时，分析 HubSpot 交易、销售管道、联系人、公司、互动、邮件活动及工作流；也用于表和模式探索、SQL 生成调试，以及复用或调整加权管道、预测校准、停滞交易、互动与赢单率、收入集中度和邮件归因分析。
